body:
Clicking "Other models" in the chat model menu no longer closes the menu, and the "Use agent model" row is gone from the model list.

The menu renders in a portal, but React clicks still bubble to the composer. The composer focuses its editor on any click that is not on a button, link or similar, so the "Other models" row (a menu item) pulled focus out of the menu and closed it. The row now stops that click.

"Use agent model" is dropped while a concrete model is selected. It still shows when the session is on the agent default, so that state always has a selected row.

Tested in the desktop app on an isolated daemon, and with a new unit test that expands and collapses "Other models" with a click-catching parent standing in for the composer.
